column1: # Shared German gender lexicon: head-noun (lowercase, visible form) <TAB> gender (m/f/n/p).
# Loaded by BOTH the token replacer (VariableReplacers.de.cs) and the runtime DLL
# (COQDE Gender), so grammatical gender has ONE source of truth. Fixes wrong articles
# Include real-umlaut AND folded (ae/oe/ue/ss) spellings. Plural = p. Extend freely
# (Haiku-fillable); lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# --- neuter nouns the -e/-er/-en heuristic gets wrong ---
